best_for: People and families who want one paid vault across Windows, Mac and Linux, and who are fine keeping their passwords in a 1Password account rather than a local file.

points.title: A subscription, with no free plan
points.text: Individual is listed at USD 3.99 per month and Families at USD 5.99 per month for five people, both billed yearly, after a 14-day trial that needs no card. At the time of reading, new direct customers got 25% off the first 12 months. Business plans go through sales. Prices were read on the date below.

points.title: You need a 1Password account
points.text: 1Password 8 has no standalone vaults. Anyone still on local vaults from version 7 has to move that data into a 1Password account before upgrading.

points.title: If you stop paying
points.text: The account freezes. You can still open, view and copy your items, but you cannot add or edit them or fill them in the browser until you subscribe again.

points.title: Two Windows installers, two behaviors
points.text: The MSIX package, for x64 and Arm64, needs Windows 10 20H1 or later and is required for saving passkeys on Windows 11. The MSI is x64 only and installs for the whole machine, which suits older builds and managed fleets.

points.title: Mac needs Monterey or later
points.text: The Mac app runs on macOS 12 and later, with Intel and Apple silicon builds. Some features need more: Autofill outside the browser requires macOS 14.

points.title: The Linux Flatpak is the real one
points.text: Flathub marks the 1Password Flatpak as verified, published by 1Password, for x64 and Arm64. 1Password also lists Debian 11, Fedora 32 and Ubuntu 20.04 or later as supported, with glibc 2.31.

points.title: Older Windows builds only
points.text: The Windows listing keeps 94 versions. macOS and Linux list only the current release, so downgrades there need another source.
